mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1400K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals tightening, increasing borrowing costs and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of tightening periods (FEDFUNDS > 5%).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) sustains labor market health, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% YoY and simultaneously, the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 2.5%, the combined effect predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in post-shock recovery regimes, a rise in real disposable income (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM predicts increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in post-shock recovery periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and stable CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL between 2% and 3%) supports moderate economic growth, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a drop in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 50K jobs in a month signals labor market weakness, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 55% of instances when PAYEMS drops by more than 50K jobs.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) is below 2% and simultaneously, the industrial production growth (INDPRO) is negative YoY, the combined effect predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met.
